answer: Idle-alias relic decay stops sybil farms from stockpiling dormant identities. An alias with no completed job for 6 epochs is marked a relic and loses its right to take new work. Waking it costs a 50 POA fee plus one fresh job checked by 3 random peers. Each epoch, gale sweeps pick 8 percent of relics and re-check their last job with its counterparty. A relic that fails the check is deleted and its fee is burned, and every alias sharing its vertex is frozen for 4 epochs. A farm holding 200 idle aliases pays 10,000 POA just to wake them.
